related_questions.question: What are the symptoms of the new COVID variant stomach?

While similar to other Omicron variants, these new variants, like the one named NB.1.8.1, can cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, heartburn, bloating, constipation, and stomach pain. Other common symptoms include fever, cough, fatigue, loss of smell or taste, and sore throat.
